entries.note: A parcel's traceStatus, which the page labels Preparing and explains as a parcel handed to the warehouse or handled there. It may come before any scan, so it says no more than registered; a scan staged accepted refines it.
A parcel's traceStatus, which the page labels In Transit and explains as anything from the handover to a carrier to customs and transport in the destination country, so a staged scan refines it.
A parcel's traceStatus, which the page labels Undelivered and explains as a delivery attempt that failed.
A parcel's traceStatus, which the page labels Delivered.
An order scan, the first a parcel gets, before Shouwu has it.
A handover scan of trace type TRACE_TYPE_TAIL. The page's In Transit status starts at the handover to a carrier, and the parcel's status was In Transit with it.
